name: How long does a shingle roof replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a shingle roof replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shingle roof replacement project typically depends on the roof's size, complexity, weather conditions, and the extent of any underlying damage. For an average-sized residential home, the process usually takes between 1 to 3 days from start to finish. This includes removing old shingles, inspecting and repairing the roof deck, installing new underlayment, flashing, and shingles, and a thorough cleanup. Larger or more complex roofs, or those requiring significant repairs, may take longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: A shingle roof replacement for an average home typically takes 1 to 3 days, depending on roof size, complexity, and weather.
